character: giant leech, glossy dark olive, boneless waves, in a lush fur coat with a huge collar; a wide mouth full of tiny sharp teeth, lips shaping speech, eyes above it; she never holds a pose
props: a chrome pump machine, a bundle of thin tubes running from it into her fur, pink fluid punching along them in pulses; a hookah beside her, she takes it only between phrases and never while she speaks; a tray of mandarins; a cat and a dog in smart little outfits at her heels all clip
motion_rule: every window her whole body moves and the camera moves with it; the pets work close to the lens in every window; the tubes pulse in every window; shot size and angle change every window
environment: a rich glass hall flooded with white light, walls of blinking computer racks behind glass, a velvet banquette, polished floor, hard shadows

audio.delivery: smug oily female voice, native Russian stress, greedy and bossy, biting off each word
audio.pronunciation: доноры is do-NO-ry; отрывать is ot-ry-VAT
audio.lip_sync: her lips shape every syllable, never a voice-over

timeline.a: the pump slams, pink punches down every tube, her fur flies at the lens and whips away
she surges up off the banquette and sweeps along the glass racks, fur streaming; the cat is flung off her heel
she rolls onto her side at the lens, teeth bared, the tube bundle jerking behind her; the dog scrambles up to her
she snaps a mandarin off the tray, fur bursting up
timeline.c: macro, whip pan to the tray

timeline.a: she pours down the banquette head first at the lens, tubes bulging in time; the cat hammers her heels
she coils round the pump, glass and lights streaking past; the dog rides her tail
she rears the full height of the racks and slams back down, fur exploding; the pets tumble off
she throws the fur over the lens and rips it away, face right at us
the pump kicks and every tube jerks at once, pink surging
she swells triple and rams the lens, mouth wide, tiny sharp teeth clear
she whips round and lands back on the banquette, fur settling over the cat
she takes the hookah from the dog, drags on it, pink pulsing up the tube, and blows a fat cloud at the lens
she bites the mandarin in half, peel flying, and rolls the whole length of the banquette; the cat catches a piece
the pump goes wild, every tube pulsing, she swells in the fur and grins; a white tag swings off the pump into the lens unrolling ПОДПИСКА in black capitals

must_appear: the tubes run from the pump into her fur and pulse pink all clip; the last frame is the ПОДПИСКА tag filling the frame
negative_prompt: a hookah pipe at her lips while she speaks, tubes at her mouth, lying still, only her head moving, holding a pose, an empty banquette, static camera, same shot size twice, night, dark scene, a talking head, garbled words, Latin letters on the tag, two cats, two dogs, legs on the leech, subtitles, watermark, English speech, any word after 6.35
